title: Capture counters
description: Totals since the archive started, except buffered, a level. At every instant received = committed + rejected + buffered + dropped.

received.description: Captures in appends the archive accepted, counted at acceptance.

buffered.description: A level: captures accepted and not yet answered, now.

dropped.description: Captures accepted and lost while the archive kept running (a buffer shed under pressure). A crash's loss is not counted: counters start at zero; the producer sees no result. A conforming archive that never drops reports 0.

oldest_buffered_ms.description: How long the oldest buffered capture has waited: the lag.
